title: Quadratic class and unit groups
objective: Implement exact Minkowski triviality, continued-fraction real-quadratic units, and ordinary/narrow real-quadratic class groups in a new strict module with focused tests and oracle comparisons

handoff.summary: Added a strict ordinary-Python quadratic engine with exact squared Minkowski comparisons, principal-form continued-fraction fundamental units and replayable minimality data, exhaustive primitive reduced-indefinite-form ordinary/narrow class groups, exact composition and canonical maps, ideal-basis representatives, resource caps, a 14-field Sage/PARI oracle corpus, and focused performance/corruption coverage. The focused Sage.js suite and strict baselib gate pass on linux-x64; discriminant 12 proves sqrt(12)/2 < 2 and yields ordinary invariants () versus narrow invariants (2,).
risks: Enumeration is intentionally complete but O(D) in the discriminant and is the small/moderate-discriminant P1 path, not the later Shanks/Buchmann large-discriminant backend.
The offline Magma command is recorded but no Magma executable was available in this workspace; the committed numerical corpus was executed against SageMath 10.9.post30/PARI 2.18.1.
Only linux-x64 was executed in this lane; native Windows x64, Linux arm64, and macOS arm64 validation remains a central integration responsibility.
next_steps: Integration lane should route positive degree-two field discriminants to real_quadratic_class_unit_context while retaining the existing imaginary reduced-form backend, and transport (x + y*sqrt(D))/2 through the field's certified square-root element.

Run pnpm test:changed, pnpm test:native, and exact-revision four-platform CI after merging all number-field class/unit lanes; the broad local self-hosting build was deliberately stopped at integration request after focused and strict receipts passed.
Oracle lane may replace the recorded Magma command metadata with an executed Magma receipt when a licensed executable is available.
